correctness.rationale: PASS: Definitions and bidegree convention are those of arXiv:2112.07004. Six explicit facet lists and an exhaustive bistellar-flip closure produce six pairwise nonisomorphic Klein-bottle triangulations. Exact rational chain complexes for every induced subcomplex, alternating restrictions, checked square-zero differentials, and six sets of computed differential ranks reproduce the three claimed profiles. H2 of every induced complex vanishes over Q. The calculation proves a finite six-type classification, not an infinite assertion; integral torsion is not determined.

originality.rationale: PASS on accessible evidence: The defining arXiv:2112.07004 includes RP2 and other examples but not the six Klein-bottle rational profiles. arXiv:2308.15702 studies rank obstructions and other examples (including a known rank-two non-wedge-decomposable case), not this exact classification; arXiv:2404.06763 concerns facet operation formulas, without implying the computed rank table. Searches in published mathematical findings show the six-type flip graph and separate mod-two homology invariants, not the Hochster differentials or rational HH ranks. Unindexed calculations remain possible.

value.rationale: PASS: All six vertex-minimal Klein-bottle triangulations share the same closed nonorientable surface and f-vector (8,24,16), yet the complete rational bigraded double-cohomology table takes three distinct profiles (total ranks 2,4,6). This provides an invariant that separates natural minimal triangulations beyond ordinary topology or face numbers; it fills an explicit finite nonorientable benchmark for an invariant previously studied mainly on other families.
